---
title: "Blood products — model fitting"
format: html
---

- Prespecified: adjusted model for all blood products. All other models are additional.

```{r}
#| label: setup

library(brms)
library(posterior)
library(arrow)
library(here)
library(knitr)
library(yaml)
library(tidyverse)

config <- read_yaml(here("config", "analysis.yml"))

results_dir <- here("analysis", "07-blood-products", "results")

blood_data <- read_parquet(file.path(results_dir, "analysis-data.parquet"))
completed_datasets <- readRDS(file.path(results_dir, "completed-datasets.rds"))
spline_knots <- readRDS(file.path(results_dir, "spline-knots.rds"))

blood_outcomes <- c(
  blood_products = "n_blood_products",
  erythrocytes = "n_erythrocyte_concentrates",
  thrombocytes = "n_thrombocyte_concentrates"
)
```

## Model formulas

```{r}
#| label: model-formulas

# Knots are written into the formula as numbers so predictions on new data
# use the same basis.
ns_call <- function(variable) {
  knots <- spline_knots[[variable]]

  sprintf(
    "splines::ns(%s, knots = %s, Boundary.knots = c(%s, %s))",
    variable,
    knots[2],
    knots[1],
    knots[3]
  )
}

adjusted_terms <- paste(
  "tx",
  ns_call("hemoglobin"),
  ns_call("platelet_count"),
  ns_call("age"),
  ns_call("creatinine"),
  "ecog_group",
  "offset(log(exposure_days))",
  sep = " + "
)

unadjusted_terms <- "tx + offset(log(exposure_days))"

blood_formulas <- list(
  adjusted = map(blood_outcomes, \(outcome) {
    bf(as.formula(paste(outcome, "~", adjusted_terms)))
  }),
  unadjusted = map(blood_outcomes, \(outcome) {
    bf(as.formula(paste(outcome, "~", unadjusted_terms)))
  })
)
```

## Priors

- Alternative priors tested: adjusted all-product rate ratio stayed 0.67–0.70.

```{r}
#| label: priors

blood_priors <- c(
  # Flat default is improper: no thrombocyte transfusions at ECOG 3+.
  prior(normal(0, 10), class = "b"),
  # Pre-2.21 brms default; the new default lets chains escape to the Poisson limit.
  prior(gamma(0.01, 0.01), class = "shape")
)
```

## Fitting

```{r}
#| label: fit-models

model_grid <- expand_grid(
  outcome = names(blood_outcomes),
  adjustment = c("adjusted", "unadjusted")
) |>
  mutate(
    seed = config$seeds$supporting + 2400L + row_number(),
    model_path = file.path(
      results_dir,
      paste0("model-", outcome, "-", adjustment, ".rds")
    )
  )

thresholds <- config$diagnostics

# Convergence diagnostics of one fit: R-hat and bulk and tail ESS over all
# parameters (including lp__), divergences, transitions at the maximum tree
# depth, and the smallest E-BFMI across chains.
fit_diagnostics <- function(fit) {
  draw_summary <- summarise_draws(fit, "rhat", "ess_bulk", "ess_tail")
  nuts <- nuts_params(fit)
  max_treedepth <- control_params(fit)$max_treedepth

  tibble(
    iterations = fit$fit@sim$iter,
    max_rhat = max(draw_summary$rhat),
    min_ess_bulk = min(draw_summary$ess_bulk),
    min_ess_tail = min(draw_summary$ess_tail),
    divergences = sum(nuts$Value[nuts$Parameter == "divergent__"]),
    treedepth_hits = sum(
      nuts$Value[nuts$Parameter == "treedepth__"] >= max_treedepth
    ),
    min_bfmi = min(rstan::get_bfmi(fit$fit))
  )
}

passes_thresholds <- function(diagnostics) {
  with(diagnostics, coalesce(
    max_rhat <= thresholds$max_rhat &
      min_ess_bulk >= thresholds$min_ess_bulk &
      min_ess_tail >= thresholds$min_ess_tail &
      divergences <= thresholds$max_divergent_transitions &
      treedepth_hits <= thresholds$max_treedepth_exceeded &
      min_bfmi >= thresholds$min_bfmi,
    FALSE
  ))
}

pwalk(model_grid, \(outcome, adjustment, seed, model_path) {
  if (!file.exists(model_path)) {
    fits <- if (adjustment == "adjusted") {
      # brm_multiple() seeds only compilation; seed R's RNG for the Stan seeds.
      set.seed(seed)

      brm_multiple(
        blood_formulas$adjusted[[outcome]],
        data = completed_datasets,
        family = negbinomial(),
        prior = blood_priors,
        init = 0,
        chains = 4L,
        iter = 2000L,
        cores = 1L,
        seed = seed,
        combine = FALSE,
        refresh = 0L
      )
    } else {
      list(brm(
        blood_formulas$unadjusted[[outcome]],
        data = blood_data,
        family = negbinomial(),
        prior = blood_priors,
        init = 0,
        chains = 4L,
        iter = 2000L,
        cores = 1L,
        seed = seed,
        refresh = 0L
      ))
    }

    # A fit that misses a diagnostic threshold is refitted once with twice
    # the iterations and a new seed, the rule used for the Markov and BSC
    # models.
    fits <- imap(fits, \(fit, index) {
      if (passes_thresholds(fit_diagnostics(fit))) {
        return(fit)
      }
      update(fit, iter = 4000L, seed = seed + 500000L + index, refresh = 0L)
    })

    saveRDS(fits, model_path, compress = "xz")
  }
})

blood_fits <- model_grid |>
  mutate(fits = map(model_path, readRDS))
```

## Diagnostics

```{r}
#| label: model-diagnostics

blood_diagnostics <- blood_fits |>
  mutate(diagnostics = map(fits, \(fits) {
    list_rbind(map(fits, fit_diagnostics), names_to = "imputation")
  })) |>
  select(outcome, adjustment, diagnostics) |>
  unnest(diagnostics) |>
  mutate(passed = passes_thresholds(pick(everything())))
```

```{r}
#| label: tbl-model-diagnostics
#| tbl-cap: "Convergence diagnostics per model and imputation"

kable(blood_diagnostics, digits = 3)
```

- Fits passing every threshold: `r sum(blood_diagnostics$passed)` of `r nrow(blood_diagnostics)`

```{r}
#| label: tbl-combined-coefficients
#| tbl-cap: "Posterior coefficients of the adjusted combined blood-product model (first imputation)"

blood_fits |>
  filter(outcome == "blood_products", adjustment == "adjusted") |>
  pull(fits) |>
  pluck(1, 1) |>
  fixef() |>
  kable(digits = 3)
```
